linear_model.description: Linear effect of log review length

spline_model.description: Cubic regression spline with 4 basis degrees of freedom

model_comparison.interpretation: Positive AIC difference favors the spline model. The likelihood-ratio test compares the nested likelihoods under standard binomial assumptions.

caution: The likelihood-ratio p-value is not product-cluster robust and relies on binomial likelihood assumptions. Earlier diagnostics showed a Pearson dispersion ratio around 2.12. Treat this as a diagnostic comparison, not definitive evidence of nonlinearity. If the spline is favored, inspect its predicted curve and consider a product-aware or robust follow-up comparison.
